rules.rule: Count genuine current completion only as of the effective business observation
rules.source: Approved Remaining Allocation v8 PR-02 and Unified Repair v10 F1 (future material completion).
rules.initialization: An original material verification is recorded as completed at 04:00 in the isolated native system, then detail, list and derived selection observe before, at and after that instant.
rules.dateAndPermission: Apply observation within the same authorization and existing task identity. Preserve recorded dates, explicit inheritance, quantity coverage, role filtering and missing/untrusted time.
rules.expectation: At 03:00 both completion percentages and actual completion exclude the event. The exact 04:00 instant and 05:00 count once. No task status or business event is rewritten.

rules.rule: Keep the effective rework responsibility result separate from later order review and finance
rules.source: Approved Remaining Allocation v8 PR-02 and Unified Repair v10 C2 (exact rework window).
rules.initialization: A genuine two-PO rework registers approved work at 48h with separate native assignments, partial reports and subsequent quantity/administrative reviews.
rules.dateAndPermission: Exact rework, line, process and approved original assignment members must all have trusted evidence. Another PO cannot erase or borrow this window; missing, partial or ambiguous evidence of this window remains unknown.
rules.expectation: Actual effective rework ends at 50h and remains 120 minutes late at later observations and after finance. While administrative evaluation is pending, order status does not become completed.
